source_snapshot.procedure: Physically check OOB LAN LED status.
source_snapshot.criteria: Link off: green off/yellow off; linked idle: green on/yellow off; activity: green blinking/yellow off.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; collects software link state and correctly leaves color/blink observation to an operator.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Keep Manual Only, require exact port/legend, controlled three-state fixture, visual evidence and alternate management recovery.

old_problem: The source did not map the BMC/OOB interface to its physical connector or specify how to create and prove disconnected, linked-idle and active states, how visual color/blink evidence is captured, or how management is restored. Software carrier state cannot observe LED color.
disposition_reason: The physical purpose and exact three-state legend are explicit. ED-09 requires a human to perform the cable/visual action and ED-08 requires genuine visual evidence; exact port mapping, fixture and evidence storage are safe project/runtime bindings under ED-03 rather than reasons to retain Engineering Decision Pending.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row390 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2982 and unique variant.
Kept physical green/yellow color and blinking observation as Manual Only; ip/ethtool/counters are synchronized corroboration and never substitute for human visual evidence.
Retained all three states, exact yellow-off rule, 10-minute allocations, alternate-management safety and final reachability restoration.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row391 and verified its manifest identity; no cable, link, traffic or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Mapped OOB LAN three-state physical LED legend verification
test_case.purpose: Visually prove the exact physical OOB management connector displays the specified green/yellow LED behavior for link-off, linked-idle and active-traffic states while software evidence corroborates each controlled state and final management access is restored.
required_package: BMC/OOB logical interface, MAC, switch port and chassis physical connector/LED map
Hardware-revision LED legend confirming green/yellow roles and acceptable blink interpretation
Approved cable/link partner, idle-link fixture and bounded traffic generator
Independent console or alternate management path before disconnecting the OOB link
Qualified operator/witness, timestamped photo/video method and protected evidence location
test_case.test_command: With alternate management established, capture mapped-interface software baseline; a qualified operator creates the exact link-off, linked-idle and bounded-activity states on the approved physical OOB connector, records timestamped photo/video showing both LEDs in each state, and correlates each observation with target-bound carrier and traffic counters; restore the original cable/link and verify BMC/OOB reachability.
test_case.expected_result: Link off shows green off and yellow off; linked with no activity shows green on and yellow off; active traffic shows green blinking and yellow off. The evidence clearly identifies the correct connector and controlled state, software carrier/counters corroborate timing, and final OOB reachability and cabling are restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires direct operator visual evidence for color and blink in all three states, exact port mapping and synchronized fixture/software state. ethtool output, carrier state or counters alone cannot establish physical LED color/blinking; ambiguous imagery or missing state cannot pass.
safety_gate: Establish independent console/alternate management and verify the exact OOB connector before any cable action
Qualified operator performs physical work; do not disturb production data links or an unmapped/sole management path
Preserve BMC/network logs and bound activity traffic to the mapped port
Stop and restore original cabling immediately on access loss, wrong port, unexpected network effect or ambiguous state; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: BMC/interface/MAC/switch/physical-port map and hardware LED legend
Timestamped photos/video showing both LEDs for link-off, linked-idle and activity
Synchronized target-bound carrier/counter evidence for each state
Preserved logs and final cable/link/BMC reachability restoration
test_case.recovery: On management loss or wrong-port change, stop the fixture, return the mapped connector to its documented original cable/switch port, verify carrier/address/route and BMC access through alternate console, preserve evidence and escalate rather than repeating automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Master and historical review agree on physical LED observation; the Review layer adds mapping and visual evidence without changing the green/yellow legend.

blocked.reason: Physical method, three states, evidence and recovery are complete; port/fixture/operator values are execution prerequisites.
